en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European town square or open space with unpaved ground. In the foreground stands a two‑storey plastered house with a steep, tiled hip roof and dormer windows, surrounded by a low wooden fence. To its right are larger, older houses with steep gabled roofs and dormers, partly covered with vegetation, and behind them rises a tall building with a high, patterned roof and small spires, possibly a church or town hall. On the left edge of the scene is a row of simpler houses; a young girl in a dress stands on the sidewalk near an old streetlamp. The scene has an early‑20th‑century atmosphere. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
